fields.System.Title: CNT-304 — Record an investigation note
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to record why a variance happened, so that counting
fixes causes instead of endlessly correcting symptoms.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a variance above the investigation threshold, then a note with a cause category
  • is mandatory before approval.
  • - Given the cause categories, then they are specific: mis-pick, mis-putaway, damage not
  • recorded, master data error, theft suspected, unknown.
  • - Given notes over time, then they are reportable by category, zone, and product.
  • - Given a variance below the threshold, then a note is optional.
  • - Given "unknown" chosen repeatedly for the same location, then it is surfaced as a
  • pattern worth investigating.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting |
| Tables | variance |
| Risks | High variance accepted without investigation ([doc 05 WF 10](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
